chapters.label: The equaliser, live
chapters.text: Eindhoven, 2023, Champions League final. Barcelona trail Wolfsburg two-one, when Aitana Bonmatí skips free on the right. Patri Guijarro is arriving, unmarked. In comes the cross... Header! Goal! Two-two!

chapters.label: Reading the cross
chapters.text: Watch Patri. Every defender watches the ball, but she reads where the cross will land, and runs into the gap.

chapters.label: One touch
chapters.text: One touch: a thumping header past Merle Frohms. Her second goal in two minutes!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: Reading early is her signature. It wins the ball back in midfield too: read the pass early, step in, then pass forward straight away.
